description: This file defines the class SetAttributeQuickFix, which implements AndroidLintQuickFix to provide quick fix functionality for setting attributes in Android XML files within an IDE environment.

classes.name: SetAttributeQuickFix
classes.description: A class implementing quick fix for setting attributes in Android XML files, providing UI prompts and IDE manipulations.

methods.name: SetAttributeQuickFix
methods.description: Constructor initializing the quick fix with name, attribute name, and optional value.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the quick fix.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the quick fix by setting the specified attribute in the XML tag, optionally prompting the user for a value.

methods.name: askForAttributeValue
methods.description: Prompts the user to input or select a value for the attribute.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Determines if the quick fix is applicable in the current context.
